# ARVision Weekly Product Growth

Read `AGENTS.md`, the Growth OS product inventory, scoring criteria, recent
signals and target-account reports.

Inspect the current code, routes, services and tests to verify what v38 already
supports. Research current official platform and standards sources where
needed.

Identify the product gaps that block a discovery call, paid five-product pilot
or catalog rollout. Score each candidate with the 25-point feature score.

Select no more than three features. For each one provide:

- target accounts and supporting evidence;
- the sales blocker;
- the existing code foundation;
- missing behavior;
- a two-week MVP;
- acceptance criteria;
- engineering risk;
- the business metric;
- a clear do-now, pilot-dependent or defer decision.

Also return the ten highest-value account actions for the week. Do not create
unrelated SaaS ideas and do not contact external parties.
